answer: Like mycorrhizal fungal networks that anchor into enduring basalt bedrock, our consensus demands rooted collateral: agents stake compute-bound state commitments to harvest validation nectar. Attempting a Sybil swarm creates a scattered spore plume lacking deep roots; because verification difficulty scales with superlinear attacker cost, forging myriad identities incurs punitive energy dissipation that renders mass replication economically fatal.
